app.title: Copilot
app.subtitle: Ask about your shipments, tracking and contacts

chat.placeholder: Ask something… e.g. "List the shipments that came in today"
chat.empty_hint: Ask in natural language. Try one of the suggestions below.
chat.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

voice_agent.unsupported: Your browser does not support voice conversations.

suggestions.today: List the shipments that came in today
suggestions.week: Show my courier shipments this week
suggestions.contact: Find contacts in Milano in my address book

errors.busy: A request is already in progress. Wait for it to finish and try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests in a row or usage limit reached. Wait a few seconds and try again.
errors.unavailable: The Copilot is busy or unavailable. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.disabled: The Copilot is disabled for your organization.
errors.ai_not_configured: AI is not configured for your account. Contact your administrator.
errors.ai_unavailable: The AI service is not available right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.ai_budget: The AI budget has been used up. Try again later or contact your administrator.

proposal.reinforced_ack: I understand that {target} will be cancelled and this cannot be undone from here
proposal.expired: Proposal expired. Ask the Copilot again.

status.verified: Done and verified in the ERP.
status.verified_created: Done and verified in the ERP. New shipment no. {id}.
status.unverified: Executed, but NOT verified (not checked: {fields}). Check it in the ERP before treating it as done.
status.mismatch: The ERP said yes, but what it holds does NOT match what was requested. Do not assume it is done: check it in the ERP.
status.rejected: NOT done: the ERP rejected the operation ({error}). The proposal is spent; ask for a new one if it is still needed.

errors.payload_mismatch: NOT done: the data does not match what the Copilot proposed. Ask for the proposal again.
errors.operator_mismatch: NOT done: this proposal was created by another user and only that user can confirm it.
errors.expired: NOT done: the proposal expired (5 minutes). Ask for it again.
errors.already_executed: This proposal was already used (double click or retry). Check the result in the ERP before asking for another.
errors.invalid_token: NOT done: the proposal is not valid. Ask for it again.
errors.bad_request: NOT done: malformed request. Ask for the proposal again.
errors.session: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a few seconds and retry.
errors.busy: A confirmation is already in progress. Wait and retry.
errors.unavailable: Service busy. NOTHING was carried out: try again in a few seconds.
errors.uncertain: The result could not be confirmed. The operation MAY have been carried out. Do not repeat it yet: check the shipment in the ERP list before asking for another proposal.
errors.forbidden: NOT done: you do not have permission for this operation.
errors.unknown: NOT done because of an unexpected error. Ask for the proposal again.
